

# route.exe is all Rust (route-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/route-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# route.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/route-rust/src/route/route.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(route_res OBJECT route.rc)
target_compile_definitions(route_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(route_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
target_compile_definitions(route_res PRIVATE _CRT_NON_CONFORMING_SWPRINTFS)
set(ROUTE_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils_rust.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/pseh/libpseh.a)
if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    list(APPEND ROUTE_REUSED ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libchkstk.a)
endif()
if(ARCH STREQUAL "arm64")
    list(APPEND ROUTE_REUSED ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libchkstk.a)
endif()
add_cargo_module(route route-cargo route.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE route-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS route_res ${ROUTE_REUSED})
